layers.rna_flight: OSD-38 RNA-seq, flight vs ground (both sealed BRIC-PDFU, dark)
layers.membrane_flight: OSD-38 membrane iTRAQ proteome, flight vs ground
layers.soluble_flight: OSD-38 soluble iTRAQ proteome, flight vs ground (truncated: top 437 groups)
layers.rna_hardware: OSD-38 RNA-seq, ground: BRIC-PDFU vs closed container (both dark)

protein_quantification.psm_filter: Score > 20 and all six iTRAQ reporter intensities > 0
protein_quantification.loci: AGI locus from Sequence Id; loci with at least 2 distinct peptides (the paper's rule)
protein_quantification.soluble_rows: protein groups 1-437 (the table is cut inside group 438)
protein_quantification.normalisation: log2; each channel centred on its median; each PSM centred on its own mean
protein_quantification.summary: protein value per channel = median over its PSMs
protein_quantification.test: two-sided Student's t, 3 vs 3 (the paper's test)

set_statistic: signed: mean gene/protein statistic in the set minus the mean over all measured features
null: genomic rotation over the measured features in prereg/gene_order.tsv.gz order, 10000 offsets, seed 20261030
fdr: Benjamini-Hochberg over every testable primary row (rna_flight, membrane_flight, rna_hardware); soluble_flight rows are reported with their own BH and are not used for verdicts
verdict: observed = up/down when q < 0.05, else none; MATCH when observed equals the prediction
concordance: descriptive: Spearman correlation of protein and transcript log2FC over shared loci, OSD-38 (membrane, soluble) and OSD-522 (the first study's proteome, UniProt mapped to AGI by KEGG conv/uniprot/ath)
paintomics: job D: OSD-38 genes (log2FC; relevant = adjusted p < 0.05) + membrane proteins (relevant = p <= 0.05 and |log2FC| > 0.2) + the reference metabolite layer, same settings as job A; compared descriptively with job A (OSD-522, lit BRIC-LED)
